---
title: "Quality of life — primary model fitting"
subtitle: "Adjusted death-inclusive proportional-odds models"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

A Bayesian proportional-odds model is fitted to each completed dataset. The
outcome is ordered from best QoL (1) through death (8), so a negative treatment
coefficient favours intervention. The treatment log-odds ratio uses a
 $N(0, 0.5)$ prior. The model adjusts for baseline QoL as specified
in the SAP.

```{r}
#| label: fit-primary-qol-landmark
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
imputation_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "imputations.rds"
)
model_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "models")
diagnostic_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "diagnostics"
)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(diagnostic_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
imputations <- readRDS(imputation_path)

pcontrast_tx <- list(
  c1 = list(tx = 1),
  c2 = list(tx = 0),
  contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  mu = 0,
  sd = 0.5
)

for (index in seq_len(config$imputation$main$m)[1:50]) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  diagnostic_path <- file.path(
    diagnostic_dir,
    sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  if (!force && file.exists(model_path) && file.exists(diagnostic_path)) next

  data <- imputations[[index]]
  data$y_landmark <- factor(data$y_landmark, levels = 1:8, ordered = TRUE)
  dd <- rms::datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")

  fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "qol", index)
  model <- rmsb::blrm(
    y_landmark ~ tx + rms::rcs(baseline_q30, 4),
    pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
    data = data,
    chains = config$markov$chains,
    iter = config$markov$iterations,
    warmup = config$markov$warmup,
    seed = fit_seed
  )
  draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(rmsb::stanGet(model))
  diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(draws) |>
    as.data.frame()
  finite_rhat <- diagnostics$rhat[is.finite(diagnostics$rhat)]
  finite_bulk <- diagnostics$ess_bulk[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_bulk)]
  finite_tail <- diagnostics$ess_tail[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_tail)]
  passed <- length(finite_rhat) > 0L && length(finite_bulk) > 0L &&
    length(finite_tail) > 0L && all(
    finite_rhat <= config$diagnostics$max_rhat
  ) && all(
    finite_bulk >=
      config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk
  ) && all(
    finite_tail >=
      config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail
  )

  if (!passed) {
    model <- rmsb::blrm(
      y_landmark ~ tx + baseline_q30,
      pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
      data = data,
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      seed = fit_seed + 500000L
    )
    draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(rmsb::stanGet(model))
    diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(draws) |>
      as.data.frame()
    finite_rhat <- diagnostics$rhat[is.finite(diagnostics$rhat)]
    finite_bulk <- diagnostics$ess_bulk[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_bulk)]
    finite_tail <- diagnostics$ess_tail[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_tail)]
    passed <- length(finite_rhat) > 0L && length(finite_bulk) > 0L &&
      length(finite_tail) > 0L && all(
      finite_rhat <=
        config$diagnostics$max_rhat
    ) && all(
      finite_bulk >=
        config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk
    ) && all(
      finite_tail >=
        config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail
    )
  }
  if (!passed) {
    stop("Persistent convergence failure in primary QoL imputation ", index, ".")
  }

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  arrow::write_parquet(diagnostics, diagnostic_path, compression = "zstd")
}
```
